lessons.title: Chat completion tests must assert JSON observability fields and cached body, not header presence
lessons.trigger: Verify FAIL on 001-llm-router-gateway: cache-hit and observability mutants survived
lessons.rule: For OpenAI-shaped completion responses, tests SHALL assert JSON cached (bool), latency_ms (number), provider (string), matching X-Cache/X-Latency-Ms/X-Provider headers, and the stored completion content on cache hits. Header presence and cached=true alone are weak.
